projects.name: PulseDB
projects.desc: An embedded time-series storage engine written in Rust with sub-millisecond range queries and vectorized compression.
projects.long: PulseDB is a lightweight embedded time-series database designed for edge telemetry and local developer metrics. It features gorilla-style delta encoding, memory-mapped segment files, and a zero-allocation query iterator.

projects.name: TermFlow
projects.desc: A fast terminal multiplexer and task runner with live dependency graphs and structured log filtering.
projects.long: TermFlow orchestrates local microservices and build pipelines from a single declarative manifest. It streams colorized output, detects port conflicts automatically, and exports execution timelines.

projects.name: TraceKit
projects.desc: Zero-overhead OpenTelemetry trace viewer that runs entirely in the browser from JSONL trace dumps.
projects.long: TraceKit lets engineers inspect distributed traces locally without spinning up heavy observability backends. Drop a trace file into the browser and inspect flamegraphs, critical paths, and span attributes.

projects.name: SchemaSync
projects.desc: Automated database migration validator that catches breaking schema changes and missing indexes in CI.
projects.long: SchemaSync parses SQL and ORM migrations in pull requests, simulates lock contention against production table statistics, and posts actionable safety reports.

projects.name: MiniKV
projects.desc: A minimal Raft-backed key-value store built to explore consensus algorithms and deterministic simulation testing.
projects.long: MiniKV implements leader election, log replication, and snapshot compaction in under 2,000 lines of C with a deterministic network simulator.

projects.name: Dotfiles
projects.desc: Modular Neovim, Fish shell, and tmux configuration tuned for fast keyboard-driven development.
projects.long: Cross-platform terminal environment with custom Lua plugins, minimal LSP setup, and synchronized color palettes.
